THE EXPERIMENT

DNS normally looks up website addresses. Follow an internal credential hidden in those requests, then compare the firewall policies.

FEATURED / SECURITY ENGINEERINGOCT 2022 — MAR 2023

AlphaReGen

Generate traffic. Configure the firewall. Inspect the evidence.

AlphaReGen combines a modular Python traffic generator/responder with a segmented VMware testbed. Students generate normal and malicious traffic, configure firewall policy, and examine the result through firewall logs and Wireshark. I led the team and built the shared software architecture that brought the protocol modules together.

Used beyond the final-year project. AlphaReGen v1 was integrated into Singapore Polytechnic’s Cybersecurity Infrastructure Configuration module.

A network built around firewall policy

Inside, Outside, and DMZ zones support traffic across trust boundaries. Our team configured and tested Palo Alto and pfSense firewalls, with routing/NAT, reusable configurations, and an administration guide.

Software that makes the network observable

Scapy packet crafting and protocol services share validation, learner support, and Wireshark filters. Learners can connect a generated action to a policy decision and the captured packets.

Python / Scapy / VMware / pfSense / Palo Alto / Wireshark
